headline: Kai, Nvidia's board spent Wednesday evening on Jensen Huang's future and announced nothing — so the premarket is writing its own verdict.
subline: Nasdaq futures are off 0.9% with Nvidia down more than 6% overnight, December now trades as a Fed hike with the 10-year at 4.99%, and Anthropic's roadshow rolls toward a Nasdaq debut next week.
asof: Pre-market · as of ≈6:40 AM ET · index strip shows futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Futures slip as Nvidia hangs over the tape
items.sentence: Nasdaq-100 futures fell 0.9% overnight with S&P 500 futures off 0.4% and the Dow broadly unchanged, per Yahoo Finance, a day after the Nasdaq Composite rallied 1.6% behind chip stocks.

items.title: December hike fully priced; only the size debated
items.sentence: After October's 0.4% CPI print, CME FedWatch put the odds of a quarter-point December hike at 87.3% and a half-point at 12.7%, per Fox Business, while Saxo says futures now price nearly 60 basis points of total tightening through March 2027.

items.title: Dollar extends its run; yen flirts with 160
items.sentence: USDJPY peaked at 159.94 — a level Japanese officials have already warned about — with the euro at a cycle low near 1.1065 and the 2-year Treasury yield up 3 basis points to 4.77%, per Saxo's quick take.

items.title: Gold tests $3,970; Brent near a two-month low
items.sentence: Brent eased 0.51% to $92.29 and WTI to $86.09 on hopes for Middle East and Russia-Ukraine diplomacy, per TipRanks, while Saxo has spot gold retreating to test support near $3,970 and calls the technical picture weak.

items.title: Claims, home sales, six Fed speakers, chip earnings
items.sentence: Weekly jobless claims land at 8:30 ET and October existing home sales at 10, per Saxo's calendar, with a 30-year auction, six Fed speakers including Hammack, Barr and Williams, and Cisco and Applied Materials reporting after the close.

items.title: US envoys back in Moscow after Abu Dhabi round
items.sentence: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived to meet Putin after two days of Abu Dhabi talks yielded agreement in principle on a prisoner exchange but no breakthrough on Donbas, per Open Chronicle's morning brief.

items.title: Strike on Gaza's Nasser hospital complex kills six
items.sentence: Palestinian health officials say an Israeli strike on the Khan Younis complex killed six people including a medical worker, per Open Chronicle, while Israel says it targeted Hamas operatives inside.

items.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns over diploma rulings
items.sentence: Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation after court rulings questioned his education credentials, per Open Chronicle, leaving lawmakers to confirm a successor nominated by President Prabowo.

items.title: G7 warns on Chinese pressure east of Taiwan
items.sentence: G7 foreign ministers said increasingly assertive Chinese maritime activity threatens regional stability and shipping, per Open Chronicle, with Taipei wary that overlapping coast-guard and military deployments could test blockade scenarios.

items.title: Mississippi's razor-close count points to Senate history
items.sentence: Open Chronicle's brief says reports indicate Democrat Scott Colom has won the Senate count — which would make him Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction — though wire coverage in recent days still described the tally as unresolved.

items.title: Nvidia's board met on Huang and announced nothing
items.sentence: The board convened Wednesday to weigh the CEO's future and no decision had been announced, per a Reuters report cited by TipRanks, and shares that closed up 2.9% fell more than 6% in extended trading.

items.title: Nvidia's own words: 'a foreign intelligence effort'
items.sentence: The board's November 8 statement has independent directors investigating reporting that Huang 'has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort,' says it has 'no reason to believe' secrets were compromised, and voices confidence in him — language now a week old.

items.title: Anthropic's roadshow points toward a $1.4 trillion debut
items.sentence: The 825-million-share offering at $70 to $78 implies up to a $1.41 trillion fully diluted valuation with Nasdaq trading as ANT possible by November 19, per Gizmodo, and KuCoin's desk notes call the book several times oversubscribed.

items.title: CoreWeave jumps 24.7%; chip index gains 5.7%
items.sentence: Wednesday's rally ran through AI infrastructure after CoreWeave's roughly 168% revenue quarter and raised guidance, per KuCoin's market report, which has the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 5.7% on the day.

items.title: MSCI drops bitcoin treasuries; Strategy braces for selling
items.sentence: Bitcoin-treasury firms including Strategy and Metaplanet come out of MSCI indexes after November 30 — Strategy estimates up to $2.8 billion in passive sales — per KuCoin, which also counts a fourth straight day of US spot-ETF outflows.
